clips.title: The story
paras: In the Deadmines, goblins keep the Goblin Foundry working for the Defias Brotherhood. Gilnid oversees craftsmen and engineers around a great smelting cauldron.
Deep beneath Moonbrook, goblin craftsmen and engineers work at the Goblin Foundry for the Defias Brotherhood. Smelters and iron ramps fill the chamber as they make anchors and cannonballs.

Gilnid oversees the goblin workforce at the foundry. Craftsmen keep production moving, while engineers use remote-controlled golems to defend the workshop. Narrow ramps and molten metal make the chamber dangerous for intruders.
